stage0064_04:r_caaab7bad760e16d.text:
$$ティエリア$$
「That was careless of me.
　To think even Amalgam saw our movements coming...」

stage0064_04:r_99b162aa6aa286a2.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「In that case, this $$ヘルマジスタン$$ itself
　may have been a trap to lure us in」

stage0064_04:r_58fb02434a1c40b2.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Amalgam...
　To think they wield such power...」

stage0064_04:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$ラッセ$$
「That's $$五飛$$'s Gundam in the lead!」

stage0064_04:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$ミレイナ$$
「Seiei and the others are aboard, desu!
　We can launch, desu!」

stage0064_04:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$トロワ$$
「Not exactly how I imagined our reunion」

stage0064_04:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$カレン$$
「So you really are going to fight」

stage0064_04:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$ゼロ$$
（So that man didn't make it in time...）

stage0064_04:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$五飛$$
「Here we go, $c!
　We crush them right here!」

stage0064_04:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「All units, scatter!
　Don't forget, this is their home turf!」

stage0064_04:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「The enemy likely has reinforcements ready!
　Cover each other's blind spots so we
　can handle them, wherever they strike!」

stage0064_04:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$ロックオン$$
「Tch...!
　Big trouble the moment we arrive!」

stage0064_04:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Guess we've got no choice but to do this!
　My M9 and Boss's got tuned up too!」

stage0064_04:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$宗介$$
「No problem.
　My mission is to master this thing」

stage0064_04:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$n
「Their words and feelings don't match at all」

stage0064_04:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$シャッコ$$
「Look, $$キリコ$$.
　There's a bunch from $$マーティアル$$ here too」

stage0064_04:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「One who craves war, one who worships war's god...
　What a fitting pair」

stage0064_04:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「All units, begin the attack!
　Annihilate the enemy forces, now!」

stage0064_04:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$マオ$$
「Watch out!
　Just as we figured, enemy reinforcements!」

stage0064_04:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$セイナ$$
「Well, isn't this nice.
　$$ゼロ$$'s here with you this time」

stage0064_04:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$カレン$$
「A21!
　Why are you guys here!?」

stage0064_04:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$セイナ$$
「Just drifting from place to place.
　This is about all we know how to do」

stage0064_04:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「So that's what Seiji Takechi left behind...」

stage0064_04:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$セイナ$$
「I'm honored, $$ゼロ$$.
　That you'd remember our leader's name」

stage0064_04:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$セイナ$$
「I hold no grudge against you, the Black Knights,
　or the world anymore. We faced the world our
　own way, and this is the life we live now」

stage0064_04:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$カレン$$
「Then I'll put a stop to that way of life!」

stage0064_04:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$セイナ$$
「That's fine by me, $$紅月カレン$$」

stage0064_04:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$セイナ$$
「Thank you, $$五飛$$.
　Because of you, we were able to find
　a way of life that was truly our own」

stage0064_04:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$セイナ$$
「It's not that we can only live through war.
　We chose war as our way of life」

stage0064_04:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Face it, $$五飛$$.
　There's no pitiful soldier here like you mean」

stage0064_04:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$五飛$$
「Don't talk like you know everything!
　Then tell me, what is $$相良宗介$$!?」

stage0064_04:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$五飛$$
「I know full well.
　That man's been relieved of guarding $$千鳥かなめ$$」

stage0064_04:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$五飛$$
「The reason he's lost his edge right now
　is because he can't accept that!
　That man is a pitiful soldier shackled by duty!」

stage0064_04:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「Our movements are being read perfectly.
　Seems the enemy has a capable commander」

stage0064_04:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「Whoever it is knows this terrain by heart.
　There could still be more reinforcements」

stage0064_04:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「Unless we take that person down,
　we'll be stuck on the defensive...!」

stage0064_04:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「Can you fight, $$ティエリア$$!?」

stage0064_04:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$ティエリア$$
「This situation needs every ounce of strength we have.
　I'll do what I can」

stage0064_04:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$ロックオン$$
「Hey, $$ティエリア$$!
　Is that the Gundam you built!?」

stage0064_04:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$ティエリア$$
「Its name is Raphael.
　It's not equipped with the original's solar furnace,
　but its combat strength leaves nothing to be desired」

stage0064_04:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$イアン$$
「Don't say that, $$ティエリア$$!
　Show me what you've got as an engineer!」

stage0064_04:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$刹那$$
「I'll leave close escort of the Ptolemy to you.
　We're counting on you, $$ティエリア$$」

stage0064_04:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$ティエリア$$
「Coming from you...
　I'll answer that trust」

stage0064_04:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「Leave the Ptolemy's defense to $$ティエリア$$,
　everyone else, go on the offensive!」

stage0064_04:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「Then we'll strike the enemy forces
　and drag their commander out!」

stage0064_04:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「Given their formation, that's their main force...!」

stage0064_04:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$刹那$$
「But I don't see any commander-type unit...!」

stage0064_04:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$ラッセ$$
「What are you doing, $$ティエリア$$!
　Charging in alone, what's the plan!?」

stage0064_04:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$ティエリア$$
「Failing to see through the enemy's trap
　and leading $c into this $$ヘルマジスタン$$
　is my responsibility!」

stage0064_04:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$ティエリア$$
「I'll draw their fire!
　If I can just do that...!」

stage0064_04:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$ザイード$$
「I won't let a good chance slip by」

stage0064_04:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Even you can't do this alone!」

stage0064_04:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$ティエリア$$
「But I did draw out their commander's unit」

stage0064_04:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$ザイード$$
「Not falling to my attack, huh...
　Seems I miscalculated a little」

stage0064_04:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$宗介$$
「A commander who knows this terrain well...
　An AS pilot armed with a Gatling Cannon...」

stage0064_04:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$ザイード$$
「But that Gundam, I will bring down for certain」

stage0064_04:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$フェルト$$
「$$スメラギ$$!
　There are people approaching this area!
　Two of them!」

stage0064_04:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$フェルト$$
「I don't know!
　But their speed is abnormal!」

stage0064_04:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「$$イアン$$!
　Launch Harute to the coordinates I give now!」

stage0064_04:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$$イアン$$
「H, hey!
　What are you saying at a time like this!」

stage0064_04:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$アレルヤ$$
「Is this Arios' successor unit...!?」

stage0064_04:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$カレン$$
「Why are you here, of all places!?」

stage0064_04:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「Talk later!
　$$アレルヤ$$!　Get on Harute with $$マリー$$!」

stage0064_04:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$ザイード$$
「Then I'll finish this before you board...!」

stage0064_04:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
$$アレルヤ$$
「I won't let you touch $$ティエリア$$!」

stage0064_04:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$$ザイード$$
「Let them get away, did I.
　Still, my advantage hasn't changed」

stage0064_04:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$ザイード$$
「From where I stand, it was a surprise
　that you ended up with $$ミスリル$$」

stage0064_04:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$$ザイード$$
「Being like this brings it back.
　Teaching you how to fight, under Majid」

stage0064_04:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$$宗介$$
「Answer the question, $$ザイード$$!
　Why are you with Amalgam!?

stage0064_04:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$ザイード$$
「I've watched plenty of fools throw their lives away
　for ideals or sentiment. They never understood that
　the world exists for the victors...」

stage0064_04:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
$$ザイード$$
「Kashim...
　I want to win.」

stage0064_04:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$クルツ$$
「What are you doing, $$宗介$$!
　I don't know if he's some old pal of yours or what,
　but blast him with the Lambda Driver!」

stage0064_04:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$宗介$$
「If I could, I'd have done it already!」

stage0064_04:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$$宗介$$
「$$アル$$!
　Why isn't the Lambda Driver engaging!?」

stage0064_04:r_124591cb154fae64.text:
$$アル$$
「System is operating normally.
　The problem lies with the operator.」

stage0064_04:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$宗介$$
「Are you saying it's my fault!」

stage0064_04:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$テッサ$$
（No wonder, given how unstable he is right now...）

stage0064_04:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$$五飛$$
（So he refuses to become the defeated one...）

stage0064_04:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「All units, concentrate fire on that red AS!
　Take out the commander and we withdraw!」

stage0064_04:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「$$ティエリア$$ and $$アレルヤ$$, form up!」

stage0064_04:r_2d09c6f6a2d990ea.text:
$$アレルヤ$$
「Right with you, $$ティエリア$$.」

stage0064_04:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$$ザイード$$
「Kashim...
　you can't beat me.」

stage0064_04:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
$$ザイード$$
「Guess it's time...
　I'll fall back here.」

stage0064_04:r_9d7b02c5e728b7aa.text:
$$宗介$$
「Like I'll let him get away!!」

stage0064_04:r_9af213fc64e0afec.text:
$$ザイード$$
「You've wasted too many rounds, Kashim.
　There can't be any left in that magazine.」

stage0064_04:r_0c705091f748360e.text:
$$ザイード$$
「I taught you this:
　in the end, victory goes to the soldier
　who saved rounds in his spare magazine.」

stage0064_04:r_53128ce8f154fd06.text:
$$ザイード$$
「...Come to think of it, I taught you one more thing...
　that in AS-to-AS close combat, a Gatling cannon
　or a monomolecular cutter is most effective...」

stage0064_04:r_1cc233cbc8c80af7.text:
$$フェルト$$
「Enemy commander's unit, confirmed destroyed...!」

stage0064_04:r_3ce2f3e58cfdc3ba.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「All units, withdraw from this area!
　Put distance between us before pursuers arrive!」

stage0064_04:r_8fe40600ce62dfbc.text:
$$玉蘭$$
「$$相良宗介$$...
　what a boring man...」

stage0064_04:r_ff4ce5f3cf96b617.text:
$$セイナ$$
（My goal of fighting $$ゼロ$$ is fulfilled...
　There's no reason left to stand on a battlefield...）

stage0064_04:r_d73c21f119847e35.text:
$$セイナ$$
（What should I do now, $$タクマ$$...）

stage0064_04:r_89766f5ffaa912d4.text:
???
「What's this, what's this...
　Seems like that famous white guy's Lambda Driver
　doesn't even work.」

stage0064_04:r_451f726d4299ea35.text:
???
「Nah.
　Plenty of others look like fun too.
　This mission's gonna be a real thrill ride.」

stage0064_04:r_e3d111e8bb190cb1.text:
???
「Been a while since my head and other parts got hot!」

stage0064_04:r_7c0d3c51f9a11ca0.text:
???
「Well then, I'll leave the rest of the command to you.
　The operation's exactly as already explained.」

stage0064_04:r_ab97c2b2418ea732.text:
???
「Where do you think you're going, Mr. Ag?」

stage0064_04:r_2ddff5064af78db4.text:
???
「Japan.
　To comfort a princess who's lost her knight.」

stage0064_04:r_050d0532c4b24bfe.text:
???
（That's the situation, Teletha.
　With someone who's shown no growth at all,
　there's no fun to be had...）

stage0064_04:r_d583fcea31bdad2e.text:
$$クルツ$$
「What are you doing, $$宗介$$!
　Hurry up and use the Lambda Driver!」

stage0064_04:r_475f7653621a91b5.text:
$$宗介$$
「If I could, I'd have done it already!」

stage0064_04:r_d69dc027cba3003f.text:
$$宗介$$
「$$アル$$!
　Why isn't the Lambda Driver engaging!?」

stage0064_04:r_3c3735172a480b72.text:
$$アル$$
「System is operating normally.
　The problem lies with the operator.」

stage0064_04:r_1f418b5594cea300.text:
$$宗介$$
「Are you saying it's my fault!」

stage0064_04:r_f87fb889124bfaef.text:
$$テッサ$$
（No wonder, given how unstable he is right now...）

stage0064_04:r_33f7fd55913419e8.text:
$$五飛$$
「So this is as far as I go...!」

stage0064_04:r_473d9a88b4ca96e7.text:
$$宗介$$
「I won't let you get away, $$張五飛$$!」

stage0064_04:r_4de6ac85c63bac12.text:
$$宗介$$
「Answer me!
　What are you fighting us for!」

stage0064_04:r_4c92652c9b1adf6f.text:
$$五飛$$
「If you can voice your own reason for fighting,
　then I'll answer that question!」

stage0064_04:r_4fb296e63cb1fb46.text:
$$五飛$$
「You can't answer, can you!
　Not when you've lost what $$千鳥かなめ$$ meant to you,
　that's an impossible ask!」

stage0064_04:r_6d77e72dbbcd7dfe.text:
$$五飛$$
「I fight to save men like you!
　This world needs war, soldiers need a reason to live!」

stage0064_04:r_d36072babd12aeb4.text:
$$カトル$$
「He's still caught in his own doubts, isn't he...」

stage0064_04:r_42a3149105314ab8.text:
$$五飛$$
「So it's $$刹那$$!
　Even Celestial Being's joined up
　with $c!」

stage0064_04:r_62ecd978c667bd29.text:
$$刹那$$
「Get out of your unit!
　All you're doing is spreading the fighting further!」

stage0064_04:r_2c7af4c55d8ac938.text:
$$五飛$$
「By your words,
　I suppose I'm no Gundam, then.」

stage0064_04:r_d584d4b5af55b1cf.text:
$$五飛$$
「But peace only breeds more fighting!
　So I'll forge an eternity called war instead!」

stage0064_04:r_db0ee69ece206fcd.text:
$$刹那$$
「True peace shouldn't give rise to fighting!
　Why won't you aim for that instead!」

stage0064_04:r_f97e6925c9e37332.text:
$$五飛$$
「Don't talk like you know everything!
　Do you even understand what true peace is!」

stage0064_04:r_422861e0b8d77d0c.text:
$$刹那$$
「Even if I don't understand it,
　there are people in this world who do, and strive for it!」

stage0064_04:r_ef16bcaa2b0e0c45.text:
$$刹那$$
「What I, what we, can do for those people
　should be to bring the fighting to an end!」

stage0064_04:r_2b93cca10f1c36a8.text:
$$刹那$$
「And what sustains that peace isn't
　overwhelming power, isn't a Gundam!
　It's the fight each and every person makes!」

stage0064_04:r_7980fd37141d88d0.text:
$$五飛$$
「You've grown eloquent...
　Is that what an Innovator is?」

stage0064_04:r_ac21212c36d2b9ad.text:
$$刹那$$
「That's right!
　We should be able to understand each other!」

stage0064_04:r_a26e2108358af7a4.text:
$$五飛$$
「I've already said all there is to say!
　If you want to stop me, come at me with force, $$刹那$$!」

stage0064_04:r_017a56991b7b8ca4.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「So you've chosen this path, $$五飛$$.」

stage0064_04:r_ad3e1db3419665fb.text:
$$五飛$$
「Do you intend to stop me, $$ゼロ$$?」

stage0064_04:r_bdc546b199c80996.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「Both you and $$シャア・アズナブル$$
　are still chasing $$トレーズ$$'s shadow.」

stage0064_04:r_22c8caf8c08c5119.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「I doubt I have the right to say this, but
　all that waits at the end of your fight is sorrow.」

stage0064_04:r_96f156e19b53fc09.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「How laughable, $$五飛$$!
　That's proof you're still bound by $$トレーズ$$!」

stage0064_04:r_feb0390bba7fe1fb.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「Shake him off, $$五飛$$!
　You could show people a path some other way!」

stage0064_04:r_8a78bcec22029401.text:
$$五飛$$
「Silence, $$ゼロ$$!
　This is the way I've chosen!
　$$トレーズ$$ has nothing to do with it!」

stage0064_04:r_f42017dfce31dea9.text:
$$五飛$$
「If you want to stop me, come with force!
　Just as you've always done,
　show me justice with greater strength!」

stage0064_04:r_ef7426919f628d8a.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「I've learned that such a thing means nothing...」

stage0064_04:r_9e994a4b926d9906.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「But, $$五飛$$!
　Cause and justice don't matter right now!」

stage0064_04:r_ffae76d2a77abf5a.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「Whatever means it takes,
　I'll stop you, as your friend!」

stage0064_04:r_3ac462d37e5893ff.text:
$$玉芳$$
「Today was only reconnaissance.
　I'm withdrawing.」

stage0064_04:r_fd6bdf7910d7d925.text:
$$玉蘭$$
「Sis... leave the rest to me.」

stage0064_04:r_d38be46e6cd7a5e5.text:
$$玉蘭$$
「Such an annoying enemy...
　I'm heading back today.」

stage0064_04:r_3fe2078328753c16.text:
$$玉芳$$
「Well done, $$玉蘭$$.
　Leave the rest to me.」

stage0064_04:r_c66844158d1ce600.text:
$$セイナ$$
（My goal of fighting $$ゼロ$$ is fulfilled...
　There's no reason left to stand on a battlefield...）

stage0064_04:r_d037ecbc1e348dc9.text:
$$セイナ$$
（What should I do now, $$タクマ$$...）

stage0064_04:r_fa59c6df081e6ae4.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「From here on, this is that woman's own problem.
　The Black Knights and Seiji Takechi don't matter anymore.」

stage0064_04:r_aa5d235c78ebe19f.text:
$$カレン$$
（$$セイナ$$, was it...
　Next time, meet me somewhere besides the field...）

stage0064_04:r_304e98dac43c9333.text:
$$五飛$$
「I've already said all there is to say!
　Come at me, $$ヒイロ$$!」

stage0064_04:r_b740d817a14afd3a.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「I'll take you on as many times as it takes,
　until you've reclaimed what you've lost...!」

stage0064_04:r_40e4c010d1b35b4c.text:
$$デュオ$$
「How far you've fallen, $$五飛$$!
　Lending a hand to some outfit like Amalgam
　just to force your twisted logic through!」

stage0064_04:r_c33abf00683a32bc.text:
$$五飛$$
「Say what you like!
　It's better than building a false peace!」

stage0064_04:r_3036adce91d1f4a8.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Don't you dare call the peace
　we finally won a fake!」

stage0064_04:r_b39a1dd705fe6cbf.text:
$$トロワ$$
「I don't expect words to stop you.
　So I'll see this through with you.」

stage0064_04:r_c9016e3ab05470b0.text:
$$カトル$$
「Please, stop this, $$五飛$$!
　How far do you mean to spread this grief?!」

stage0064_04:r_a684e6cea428e518.text:
$$五飛$$
「A false peace is the true cause of grief!
　Understand that too, $$カトル$$!」

stage0064_04:r_cf907a4d5de8b5c9.text:
$$カトル$$
「Then why are you so sad yourself?!」

stage0064_04:r_b4fa30f33e84207f.text:
$$カトル$$
「That's right!
　That's why we're stopping you!」

stage0064_04:r_9133b7e0b34de48f.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「Listen, $$五飛$$!
　$$トレーズ$$ is already dead!」

stage0064_04:r_4ae9c4bd77494c4a.text:
$$五飛$$
「I don't need you to tell me that!」

stage0064_04:r_7313331f4077d255.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「No, you don't understand at all!
　You're still haunted by $$トレーズ$$'s ghost!」

stage0064_04:r_a84ab0c3c1ba44d4.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「Look ahead, $$五飛$$!
　Both people and the world seek a new era!
　Let go of the past too!」

stage0064_04:r_414e6e90094d1413.text:
$$五飛$$
「Pathetic, $$相良宗介$$!
　Now you're a pitiful soldier with no reason to live!」

stage0064_04:r_09227dec2bd6f4d8.text:
$$五飛$$
「Still you come at me!
　Just as I thought, a soldier who lives only to fight!」

stage0064_04:r_cb6d9ee71c24b042.text:
$$カレン$$
「Why are you all even fighting?!
　You're saying being in Amalgam fills
　that emptiness inside you?!」

stage0064_04:r_ddd97a6ef823929a.text:
$$セイナ$$
「That's right, $$紅月カレン$$.
　This is the life we chose to live.」

stage0064_04:r_df349052cd9cdd0c.text:
$$カレン$$
「Is this different from our fight at Odaiba?!」

stage0064_04:r_a7ce9f908380694c.text:
$$セイナ$$
「That's right.
　This isn't for Seiji Takechi's sake,
　or out of hatred. It's a fight to live.」

stage0064_04:r_de3cc1f733dcb073.text:
$$カレン$$
「Then I won't hold back!
　Not as a Black Knight, but as $c's
　$$紅月カレン$$, I'll face you myself!」

stage0064_04:r_0835ec3fff318aff.text:
$$セイナ$$
「I wanted to meet you, $$ゼロ$$.
　We've fought all this time just to meet you.」

stage0064_04:r_c32efc7394910997.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「Seiji Takechi's right hand...
　$$セイナ$$, wasn't it?」

stage0064_04:r_b01db8213417811e.text:
$$セイナ$$
「As expected of you.
　To think you'd remember even me.」

stage0064_04:r_bc0273c6ae91c929.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「Naturally.
　How could I win without grasping my enemy's forces?」

stage0064_04:r_8deea7c70d7a76e7.text:
$$セイナ$$
「I'm glad, $$ゼロ$$.
　Hearing you say that made this meeting worth it.」

stage0064_04:r_660c72e627d873c7.text:
$$セイナ$$
（The proof of what we fought for is found...
　$$タクマ$$... I'll join you soon.）

stage0064_04:r_5d8b67b5bd8ce190.text:
$$カレン$$
「$$五飛$$!
　You're still at this?!」

stage0064_04:r_7cf3c91395139f5c.text:
$$五飛$$
「This is the fight I chose!
　Stop me if you can, $$カレン$$!」

stage0064_04:r_6ccd85652ef4ccf1.text:
$$カレン$$
「Fine, $$五飛$$!
　Fighting is the only words between us!!」

stage0064_04:r_fbe7bf7d854012a7.text:
$$五飛$$
「Knowing you,
　I thought you'd try words on me.」

stage0064_04:r_1f438885dbc1359e.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「I have no words strong enough
　to break your conviction.」

stage0064_04:r_2e59226caa35f6e5.text:
$$五飛$$
「My thanks, $$ゼロ$$!
　You understand me!」

stage0064_04:r_5d7a3adb077ad934.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「That's right, $$五飛$$!
　That's why I'll stop you by force!」

stage0064_04:r_8d461de418389bf8.text:
$$五飛$$
「What's wrong, $$刹那$$!
　If you're Celestial Being,
　then fight me as I spread this war!」

stage0064_04:r_5cb2acefa1e7c7fb.text:
$$五飛$$
「But I won't stop!
　I'll fight until this life of mine ends!」

stage0064_04:r_33f67c683bda9203.text:
$$ザイード$$
「I taught you this, Kashim.
　Fighting in a blind rage is suicide.」

stage0064_04:r_6be0d6139fac197c.text:
$$ザイード$$
「This takes me back.
　To our days at Majid's camp.」

stage0064_04:r_df899b8031b4ca06.text:
$$ザイード$$
「You were a quick learner, a fine soldier.
　But now, you're no different from a child
　charging in on raw emotion.」

stage0064_04:r_c5d048c7db7cac75.text:
$$宗介$$
「You!
　You should've died in $$ガウルン$$'s attack...!」

stage0064_04:r_308e8ac66b1141ef.text:
$$ザイード$$
「I was alive.
　Since then, that man's been my superior.」

stage0064_04:r_b6ca80db4741a62c.text:
$$ザイード$$
「He'd be disappointed to see you now.
　To think Kashim turned into a third-rate
　soldier... no, just a plain child...」

stage0064_04:r_432a29155221625f.text:
$$ザイード$$
「Call it mercy.
　I'll be the one to send you off, Kashim.」

stage0064_04:r_9f7c18d1ea1b55c9.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「It's been a while, $$五飛$$.
　I never thought we'd meet again like this.」

stage0064_04:r_56688ad8e41b7b42.text:
$$五飛$$
「$$ロジャー$$.
　Your negotiating tricks won't be enough
　to break my resolve!」

stage0064_04:r_34a510533cb8a9f5.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「That's harsh.
　Denying my whole reason for being, are you?」

stage0064_04:r_1afedc9fa466f321.text:
$$五飛$$
「Enough talk!
　If you want to stop me, come with force!
　Yes, the way you do best!」

stage0064_04:r_9547b3241808695f.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「Egging yourself on with such ugly words
　is sad to watch, $$五飛$$.」

stage0064_04:r_32b2a8ce24deeb9f.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「If pain is what you want,
　then I'll rise to the bait!
　Call it kindness between friends!」

stage0064_04:r_1be6d12f616f04e4.text:
$$五飛$$
「$$キリコ$$...!
　Not every soldier is as strong as you!
　So...」

stage0064_04:r_80f948aeaed93de8.text:
$$キリコ$$
「Stop putting on a brave face.
　It's hard to watch, taken this far.」

stage0064_04:r_4e91ccecf1dd0f66.text:
$$玉芳$$
（We can't forget our purpose, $$玉蘭$$.）

stage0064_04:r_ef339c6f71e7560f.text:
$$玉芳$$
（All of this, for sensei's sake...
　And for that, that man must...）

stage0064_04:r_ce68dd10a19e01ea.text:
$$ティエリア$$
（This Raphael is a Gundam completed by
　repurposing $$イノベイド$$ mobile suit data...!）

stage0064_04:r_13ce8d4e4858b193.text:
$$ティエリア$$
（I will fight...!
　With Raphael, to protect mankind's future,
　the $$イノベイド$$s' true purpose!）

stage0064_04:r_075101b23517fbaa.text:
$$マリー$$
「This Gundam was built as a two-seater from the start...」

stage0064_04:r_13c2ae299018c9ee.text:
$$アレルヤ$$
「Everyone's been waiting for us.
　For me... and for you.」

stage0064_04:r_afa513b4815df4c9.text:
$$アレルヤ$$
「Let's go, $$マリー$$!
　If this world needs us,
　then let's answer that call!」

stage0064_04:r_6cf1e5ed68d98bd4.text:
$$マリー$$
「Got it, $$アレルヤ$$!
　The $$ピーリス$$ in me will lend her strength!」

stage0064_04:r_e62eb587b8d34cb9.text:
$$ハレルヤ$$
（Heh... so that woman's joining the fight too.）

stage0064_04:r_d72cc2c0739c9088.text:
$$ハレルヤ$$
（Not bad!
　Guess we go in as a foursome, then!）

stage0064_04:r_e5a692ea5ce09cac.text:
$n
「I have an enemy to beat and something
　to protect! So I'll grow stronger!」

stage0064_04:r_e793fc3ce3a0c28d.text:
$$五飛$$
「Well said!
　Then prove it, and beat me!」

stage0064_04:r_f89f6c6c4b076e16.text:
$$五飛$$
「If you have a will of your own,
　then surpass someone like me!!」
